name: GamepadLab
browserMode: Browser mode: simulated data, no access to real controllers.

empty.title: No controller connected
empty.body: Plug a controller in over USB or pair it over Bluetooth and press any button. It shows up here right away.
empty.demoHint: No controller? Demo mode simulates a DualSense so you can see every screen working.
empty.mac1: Bluetooth: hold PS + Share (DualSense or DS4), the pair button (Xbox) or Sync (Switch Pro) until the light blinks, then pair in System Settings > Bluetooth.
empty.mac2: If macOS asks, allow GamepadLab under Privacy & Security > Input Monitoring.
empty.mac3: Older Xbox 360 controllers have no native driver on macOS.
empty.win1: Xbox controllers work out of the box. DualShock and DualSense too, no DS4Windows needed.
empty.win2: Close Steam or disable Steam Input, which can hide or duplicate the controller.
empty.win3: A controller that shows up twice in other apps (XInput + DirectInput) is listed once here.
empty.linux1: Install the udev rule (packaging/linux/70-gamepadlab.rules) to unlock gyro, touchpad and lightbar.
empty.linux2: If the controller does not show up, check that your user can read /dev/input/event* (input group or uaccess).
empty.linux3: Works on Wayland and X11: input is read from the kernel (evdev/hidraw), not from the display server.
empty.other1: Run the desktop app to read real controllers.

toast.disconnectedBody: If that was not on purpose, check the cable or battery and reconnect.

about.title: About GamepadLab
about.description: Open tool to test and calibrate game controllers on macOS, Linux and Windows.
about.privacy: No telemetry. No data leaves your computer. Profiles, history and reports are stored locally.
about.network: The only network connection is the optional update check, which you can turn off in settings.
about.credits: Inspired by hardwaretester.com and the PG Custom calibrator. Sony calibration commands ported from DualShock Calibration GUI (MIT, the_al); Switch memory layout documented by Nintendo_Switch_Reverse_Engineering.
about.artCredits: DualSense, Xbox Series and Switch Pro drawings based on "Button Icons and Controls" by Zacksly, licensed under CC BY 3.0 (zacksly.itch.io), modified by GamepadLab. Generic controller: original GamepadLab drawing, CC BY 4.0. Details in ASSETS_LICENSE.md.
